defs: adj	Feeling sorrow; sorrowful, mournful.
adj	Appearing sorrowful.
adj	(heading) Emotionally negative.
adj	Causing sorrow; lamentable.
adj	Poor in quality, bad; shameful, deplorable; later, regrettable, poor.
adj	(slang) Unfashionable; socially inadequate or undesirable.
adj	Of colours: dark, deep; later, sombre, dull.
adj	(obsolete) Heavy; weighty; ponderous; close; hard.
adj	(obsolete) Dignified, serious, grave.
adj	(obsolete) Naughty; troublesome; wicked.
adj	(obsolete) Sated, having had one's fill; satisfied, weary.
adj	(obsolete) Steadfast, valiant.
v	(transitive, archaic) To make melancholy; to sadden or grieve (someone).
adj	(dialect) Soggy (to refer to pastries).
n	Alternative form of saad (“Arabic letter”). [The letter ص in the Arabic script.]
n	(medicine) Initialism of seasonal affective disorder. [(psychology) A form of depression associated with the lack of natural light during the winter months.]

n	(psychology) Initialism of social anxiety disorder. [(clinical psychology, psychiatry) An anxiety disorder, characterized by intense fear in one or more social situations, causing considerable distress and impaired ability to function in at least some parts of daily life.]
n	Initialism of standard American diet.
n	(US) Initialism of Special Activities Division.
n	(Indian politics) Initialism of Shiromani Akali Dal (Indian political party)
n	(X-ray crystallography) Initialism of single-wavelength anomalous dispersion.
adj	Anxious or uneasy.
adj	(of merchandise, etc.) Damaged.
adj	(finance, of securities) Experiencing financial or operational distress, default, or bankruptcy.
adj	(of furniture, etc.) Faded or abused in order to appear old, or antique.
adj	(of a property) Offered for sale after foreclosure.
adj	Not happy; sad.
adj	Not satisfied; unsatisfied.
n	A person who is not happy.
adj	(chiefly dated) Not lucky; unlucky.
adj	(chiefly dated) Not suitable; unsuitable.
v	To make or become unhappy; to sadden.
adj	Pertaining to dysphoria, or of being in a state of dysphoria.
adj	Causing dysphoria.
n	A person who is experiencing dysphoria.
